name: areHypervisorAdminsDedicated
definition: True when at least one administrator assignment exists on the vCenter and every administrator principal is shown to be a dedicated account.
population: principals holding an Admin (or ModifyPermissions) role on a folder, datacenter, cluster, host or any propagating object of one vCenter, plus SSO Administrators
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A complete permission list in which every administrator principal is shown dedicated by directory record or admin naming convention, and none is a broad group or a mailbox account.
citations: vSphere Automation API 9.0 Vcenter Authorization Permissions (POST /api/vcenter/authorization/permissions?action=list)
